n-jared-mwa3mr97.text: Ran this through tools that mix airlines and separate legs: Google Flights multi-city, ITA Matrix and Kiwi. Best shared flight is United SFO→Haneda Sat Feb 6 at 10:20 AM, then all of us on one flight to Sapporo Sunday evening (~$90). From SF: $1,404 round trip, or $1,459 on one ticket into Sapporo. From SLC: $1,387 on one United ticket with a Friday night in SF. Korea is out this year: Lunar New Year (Feb 6–9) makes Seoul→Sapporo $267–401 with no evening flights, so we'd lose a festival day. All the fares are on this card.
